channel.title: Inland Valley Daily Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Inland Valley Daily Bulletin (dailybulletin.com)

item.title: Adam Silver: Kawhi Leonard/Clippers investigation still ongoing
item.description: The NBA commissioner addresses the salary cap scandal, expansion, tanking and WNBA collective bargaining agreement negotiations during his annual All-Star news conference.

item.title: Alexander: The NBA’s race to the bottom continues
item.description: Commissioner Adam Silver recently levied fines for lineup manipulation, and he is considering many possible remedies, from taking away draft picks to making wholesale changes to the draft and the lottery.

item.title: Mondego scores 9-1 upset at Santa Anita as Gold Phoenix struggles
item.description: The San Marcos win under Emisael Jaramillo gives trainer Michael McCarthy a 3-race win streak at the stakes level.

item.title: Swanson: In a tanking world, NBA investigating Clippers for trying too hard
item.description: Commissioner Adam Silver finds himself at an intersection with cars stalled up and down the street on one side and the possibility of a Bugatti blowing through a flashing stop sign on the other.

item.title: Keshad Johnson claims 1st dunk contest; Damian Lillard wins 3rd 3-point contest
item.description: Miami’s Johnson jumps over rapper E-40 as a part of his dunk routine, while Portland’s Lillard, sidelined for the season with an injury, edges Phoenix star Devin Booker in the 3-point final.

item.title: Update: Winter storm warning in place for Yosemite from Sunday to Wednesday – gusts to hit 60 mph
item.description: Yosemite is included in an updated winter storm warning released by the National Weather Service on Saturday at 7:51 p.m. The warning is valid from Sunday 10 p.m. until Wednesday Feb. 18, at 10 p.m.

item.title: With heavy rain expected, City of Los Angeles issues evacuation warnings for burn scars
item.description: A stretch of Topanga Canyon Boulevard (State Route 27) will close Sunday night due to possible flooding and debris flows.

item.title: Jordan Chiles earns 4th straight perfect 10 for UCLA gymnastics on floor against Michigan
item.description: The Bruins improve to 5-0 in the Big Ten with the win in front of a season-high crowd of 10,032.

item.title: IE Varsity’s CIF Southern Section playoff scoreboard for Feb. 14
item.description: See how Inland teams fared in CIF Southern Section playoff events on Saturday, Jan. 14.

item.title: 2 Hacienda Heights residents arrested after investigation of website offering commercial sex services
item.description: The suspects were arrested on suspicion of pimping, conspiracy and pandering.
